purpose: Estimation of missing Scope 3 supplier and activity carbon emissions
target_transformation: log1p(co2e_kg) during training, expm1(y_pred) at inference

dataset_summary.data_provenance: SYNTHETIC training dataset generated using DEFRA 2023, EPA eGrid 2023, and IPCC AR6 reference emission factors.

governance_and_limitations.primary_engine_rule: The rule-based CarbonCalculationEngine is the PRIMARY and authoritative calculation system.
governance_and_limitations.ml_role: ML predictions are supplementary estimates used ONLY when activity data is missing or incomplete.
governance_and_limitations.data_labeling: All predictions from this model MUST be explicitly tagged with source='ML_ESTIMATED'.
governance_and_limitations.synthetic_data_disclosure: Trained on synthetic activity datasets calibrated to IPCC/DEFRA/EPA emission factors. Not direct empirical supplier measurements.
governance_and_limitations.accuracy_boundary: High accuracy applies within standard industrial activity ranges. Extreme outlier facilities should be audited with primary supplier bills.
